rachael-partners: FYI — AegisMed signed a 2yr reserved Dedicated + Private VPC add-on. Theyre using Redwood for clinical summarization and chart ingestion. Onboarding kickoff Fri 11am PT. Need KMS customer keys + long-term audit retention. :tada:

omar-sales: Incredible — whats the expected qps/seq length? Any specific timeline for the case study?

rachael-partners: Expected steady qps ~15, avg seq ~300. Marketing wants a one-paragraph case study after 30 days of steady ops and a CTO quote. I'll intro the Aegis contact in the kickoff.

jing-engineering: Engineering can supply a 3-line tech blurb + small code snippet for docs. We'll also pre-provision a 2-node test pool for perf validation. Can ops reserve for next Wed?

paul-security: From security: require signed BAA, KMS key policy review, and exportable audit logs. Recommend HSM-backed customer-managed KMS if they insist on key isolation. I'll attach checklist to the kickoff invite.

zoe-marketing: I'll own the case study draft and PR timing. Need logo permissions and a 10-20 word customer quote by go-live. Also want a short "why Aegis picked Redwood" line — please drop one-liners here.

jing-engineering: Draft perf blurb: "p95 token latency <60ms on reserved g5 pools for typical clinical summarization; caching and batching yield ~35% lower unit costs vs DIY." Snippet (py, 4 lines):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="REDACTED")
print(client.generate(model="rwd-summarize-1", prompt="Summarize patient note").text)
```

omar-sales: One-liner on why they chose us: "Private VPC + key isolation, predictable reserved pricing, and proven latency for clinical NLP."

kickoff-bot: Onboarding ticket AM-9102 created and assigned to jing-engineering, ETA 6 days.

rachael-partners: Thanks everyone. Kickoff invite sent. Agenda: intros, compliance checklist, infra plan, case study asks. Please review the internal win doc before the call: https://redwood.internal/wins/aegismed-2026
